product.title: Private Looe Key Snorkel from Big Pine Key

description.text: Discover the Great Florida Reef while visiting the Florida Keys on this private snorkel excursion. Board a private boat and depart from Big Pine Key towards Looe Key, where you can jump in the water and explore the extensive coral reef system. Snorkel alongside your captain and learn about the various species you encounter such as barracuda, parrotfish, and rays.Discover marine species on a snorkel tour to Looe Key Avoid crowded tourist boats on this private excursion All snorkel gear is provided for your convenience A private boat and captain means a personalized experience Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
